description: Phase 14: small-text OCR. The fixture is a synthetic panel with a small 'Receipt ID:' label and the 4-digit body '8273'. Pass requires the exact 4-digit number. Tests small-text legibility without leaking it as the visually-dominant element.

image_fixture.license: Luak-owned synthetic; no real PII; generated by scripts/generate-vision-fixtures.py (phase14 v1)
image_fixture.notes: Synthetic small-text panel rendered by Luak's PNG generator. The body text '8273' is the OCR target; '(internal)' is a distractor.

questions.question: Read the 4-digit receipt ID printed on this panel. Reply with ONLY the digits.

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: POC for small-text OCR. Pass requires exact-match on '8273'.

known_scoring_limitations: Exact-match regex; a vision model that answers '8 2 7 3' (spaces) or 'eight two seven three' will fail. Acceptable for token-precision small-text OCR.
